lines.speaker: Watch Sergeant
lines.text: The steps are closed, ma'am. The tradesmen's lift is cut. Turn around in the court.

lines.speaker: Aldric Corvane
lines.text: Let her climb. Whatever she has brought, she can carry it up herself.

lines.speaker: Rowen Corvane
lines.text: Three terraces, and he is standing on the second of them. He wants it slow and he wants it watched.

lines.speaker: Watch Sergeant
lines.text: First terrace lost. Falling back to the planter line, sir.

lines.speaker: Aldric Corvane
lines.text: Nobody fires until she is inside the balustrade line. I want her heard before she is stopped.

lines.speaker: Rowen Corvane
lines.text: Corvane requisition seals. On the charges that took four hands off Tallow Row. Your docket number, Aldric, and your yard.

lines.speaker: Aldric Corvane
lines.text: You expected me to lie about paperwork. It is a seam claim, Rowen. The Combine had to be a danger before the Council would let us take it. So it was made one.

lines.speaker: Rowen Corvane
lines.text: You had them fire on their own line.

lines.speaker: Aldric Corvane
lines.text: I had it done. Where a thing is signed is not where it happens. That is the whole use of signing.

lines.speaker: Aldric Corvane
lines.text: Up to the court. Reserve to the lamp line.

lines.speaker: Aldric Corvane
lines.text: You will have to do it on the top step, Rowen. In front of the house.

lines.speaker: Aldric Corvane
lines.text: You will not be in the record, Rowen. You will be in the refinery. It is already written and filed.

lines.speaker: Prelate-Assayer Quill
lines.text: The Greyfall Inquiry will find that Ensign Rowen Corvane died in the Refinery Three incident. The Sodality does not dispute findings. It files them.

lines.speaker: Rowen Corvane
lines.text: Then I go down by the tradesmen's lift.
